text:
mike_h: proposing a 'radius release' pattern for the new routing/priority feature. idea = expand exposure in concentric windows (by tenant-weighted radius) and have explicit autofail criteria + fast fallback. doing this to reduce blast radius while testing region + tenant interactions. thoughts?

anna_p: love the name :) can you sketch windows and the exact autofail triggers? we need concrete numbers for ops/pm.

lena_r: quick note — we should include a tenant opt-out path (sales requests) and a way to prioritize paid tenants in earlier radii. otherwise flag might hit key customers.

mike_h: yep. rough sketch: windows = [10%, 25%, 60%, 100%] over ~48h total if healthy. ramp cadence: 10% -> 25% (6h hold) -> 60% (18h) -> 100% (rest). autofail rules (examples):
```
autofail: 
  - sustained_error_rate > 2% for 3m
  - p95_latency_delta > 30% over baseline for 10m
  - model-quality-regression: eval-score-drop > 3% on smoke prompt set
```
if autofail triggers, immediate rollback to previous radius and kick a pager.

jamal_k: how do we measure "tenant-weighted"? is that by request count or revenue weight? also, Dedicated vs Hosted routing: need to ensure Dedicated tenants get pinned to variant even during rollbacks.

anna_p: tenant-weighted by 7-day request volume for the initial rollout. revenue weighting is a good follow-up for commercial opt-ins. we should capture both metrics in the rollout dashboard.

sarah_ops: ops/runbook notes: add preflight checks (trace sampling, prefix cache warmup, model-variant-compatibility). run preflight job: `./tools/sim_traffic --region=us-west1 --qps=200` and validate trace retention. if autofail, run quickfix: `redwoodctl flag set radius_release_v1 0` then confirm fallback route in routing table.

lena_r: we also need an A/B arm for quality: shadow 25% of traffic to new variant but only route 5% for hard-exposure to compare outputs. avoids pure shadow vs full exposure ambiguity.

mike_h: good call. plan: in radius 25% window we run 20% shadow + 5% routed sample. that gives paired telemetry.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout job created: job_id=rb-2026-03-21-01, start=2026-03-28T16:00Z, canary_window=6h.

jamal_k: what's the rollback ladder? immediate full rollback or stepback? prefer stepback one radius then reassess, unless severity is high (data exfil or complete outage) -> full kill. document thresholds.

mike_h: agree: ladder = stepback radius, if single-step fails again -> kill-switch (full off). severity triggers (data loss, security, >15% global error) -> full off and hotfix.

anna_p: can product owners sign off on the sample prompt set for model-quality checks? I'll ping the docs PR with the list.

sarah_ops: ops will own the playbook and the runbook entry. I'll add rollback commands, monitoring queries, and postmortem template.

mike_h: next steps: I'll write the release checklist (preflight commands + telemetry queries + customer opt-out list) and post in #product by EOD tomorrow. can someone from infra confirm routing pin behavior for Dedicated? @jamal_k?

jamal_k: will check infra – if Dedicated tenants are pinned we will add a hard-exclude list to the rollout config so we don't touch them. back in 2h. :eyes:

anna_p: thanks — once infra confirms, i'll schedule the stakeholder sign-off meeting. :thumbsup:

sarah_ops: filing chaos sims: run in staging us-west1 with circuit-drop 1% and 5% synthetic latency bump. report expected on telemetry deck.

mike_h: perfect. tabletop on Thu for ops+infra+pm. if all good we'll run the first radius next week. :rotating_light:
